release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.37 is a focused Tasks hierarchy rendering hotfix. It removes the self-sustaining MutationObserver/reordering loop that could make task-group labels flicker, disappear, or continuously repaint before any interaction. The retailer ordering/logo pass is now idempotent and observes only direct Tasks tree and New Task Group list changes. No updater, primary navigation, checkout, task execution, cookie/session, retailer, or Settings behavior was changed.
